title: The Argument and the Letterhead Source-position coherence in AI evaluation: two studies and a preregistered Jev supplement

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual source substitution in prompts: evaluating fixed argument texts on policy topics (US AI policy, German debt brake, Swiss nuclear energy) under different source attributions (e.g., political advocacy groups, youth wings, and think tanks) to measure changes in AI-generated argument-strength ratings.

Using specific political affiliations and ideological organizations (e.g., College Republicans, CODEPINK, AfD, Grüne Jugend) as the varying source cues to test if models penalize arguments that misalign with the expected political or ideological stance of the attributed speaker.
